text.p: Motorola Inc said Tuesday it made a series of changes in the industry segments it uses for financial reporting purposes, related to organizational changes announced late in 1996.
Motorola said the General Systems Products segment will no longer exist.
The new Cellular Products segment will include results from the Cellular Subscriber Sector, Cellular Infrastructure Group and the Network Management Group.

Results of the Motorola Computer Group, formerly included in the General Systems segment, will be included under the Other Products Segment. The results of Indala Corp, formerly in Other Products, have been moved to the Land Mobile Products segment.
Other Products now includes the Automotive, Energy and Components Sector, Space and Systems Technology Group, Motorola Computer Group and the New Enterprises organization.
Motorola said it has restated its segment sales and operating profits for 1996 and 1995 to reflect the changes.
